title: Fire in the Dark
description:
Fire in the Dark is a multiplayer-only isometric arena shooter in which you can invite a friend to play against you. In a medieval fantasy small city, you become two witches facing each others in a duel at night. 

Play with the shadows and hide in bushes, chase down your opponent to defeat him and prove who's best! 

Use fireballs to deal damage, kindle up torches or burn down bushes! 
Alternatively, rely on frostbolts to slow down your enemy and extinguish light sources in order to discreetly hide and wait for the right occasion to strike!
description_short: Online duel isometric arena-shooter where the best witch wins! Use the power of fire and ice, navigate the shadows and hidings to defeat your opponent in a duel in the darkness. Use the light, hide in a bush, and show your friend who's the best witch in town!
